caption: The drawing features a single mechanical object positioned in the center of an otherwise empty, light beige background. The object is circular with metallic, blue-gray tones and intricate detailing. It has a cylindrical extension protruding horizontally to the left and a curved, dark-colored handle-like component attached on the right. Around the central circular face, there are decorative or functional markings in blue and gray colors. The texture shows gradients and subtle highlights, giving a sense of volume and metallic sheen. Below and to the right of the object, the text "J. CENNELLA." is printed in small, black, uppercase letters. There are no additional objects, patterns, or borders present on the drawing.
title: Center Fire Revolver
